comments: a0d7c4f5: Initializes the report generation process, including division and deficiency type selections.
e0e695b7: Handles division selection if the report is to include multiple divisions.
6a569145: Sets the division to the first one found if not handling multiple divisions.
14dee6d6: Calls the selected list template for processing.
a2229520: Prompts for date range and processes the selection.
f491aeee: Initiates the selection of deficiencies for the report.
b482214a: Asks the user if verified records should be included in the report.
59185a38: Informs the user that the report is formatted for 132 column output.
d75e20aa: Sets up the current date for use in the report header.
a3367fcd: Prepares the necessary variables and opens the device for report output.
b873b918: Gracefully exits the process if no output device is selected.
b4043d24: Begins the main loop to process and format deficiency records for the report.
290ba0f9: Branches to detailed report generation if applicable.
5c72aca2: Branches to summary report generation if applicable.
cbc61bb6: Displays a message if no records were found matching the criteria.
43c20438: Exits the routine and performs any necessary cleanup.
31da0e83: Begins a subroutine for handling service-specific processing.
58349935: Determines if a treating specialty is associated with the record and proceeds accordingly.
c7b3bedb: Ensures the treating specialty exists and sets a flag if it does not.
1c1d35b4: Processes ward and division information for the record.
ea992790: Assigns the division based on the ward information.
b08e3e20: Retrieves and sets division details.
db7b8c3d: Determines the service associated with the ward and applies selection criteria.
8a9920f2: Handles cases where the service is unspecified or does not match predefined criteria.
e870a2be: Sets the treating specialty and checks against user selections.
7120bf4a: Exits the service processing subroutine after completion.
ab1e46ba: Checks and filters records based on division selections.
3b4276b3: Filters records to match the specified division, if applicable.
6cbd2e5b: Excludes records based on 'signed no review' criteria.
c8af8d7c: Excludes records based on 'reviewed' criteria.
c3d11362: Removes records marked as 'completed' from consideration.
f103b66b: Clears temporary variables used in processing.
4fa95cc0: Excludes records without a responsible physician when required.
c5945b5a: Filters out records that have a responsible physician when not required.
16eb8d53: Applies filters based on selected deficiency types.
d1c90f6a: Excludes records outside the user-selected date range.
fe374bad: Applies physician selection criteria for the 'PHY' sort option.
71900f58: Filters patient records based on selected patients for the 'PAT' sort option.
5e27c8ac: Excludes summary records from service records display, based on selection.
7925b223: Tracks division names and maintains counters for report totals.
445a7f97: Formats patient name and ID for display within the report.
14e1f7d3: Processes and sorts physician-oriented records for inclusion.
51f45ebc: Sorts patient-oriented records for report generation.
37c41a38: Handles sorting of records by service, preparing for report generation.
c6f684ec: Applies service record filters based on user selections.
6a543a6e: Filters service records by selected specialty, applying user criteria.
6816afd1: Exits the checking routine if the record does not meet the established criteria.
76819843: Stores service records that meet all specified criteria for report inclusion.
4d179b34: Concludes the check routine, moving to the next record or phase as needed.
55d85e0d: Initializes physician selection for report criteria.
7f679d24: Exits the physician selection subroutine.
941c9c71: Begins patient selection process for report criteria.
67f1e7bc: Concludes the patient selection subroutine.
a28d0375: Starts the service selection process, including relevant specialties.
d5756d9a: Completes specialty selection for service-related report criteria.
4c17556f: Ends the service and specialty selection subroutine.
